name: stac-va-pomcp-t9
purpose: Reported external number for the value-arms held-out (no gate): planner_pv2_tiles_va_t9 as one seat vs 3 STAC POMCP-TS-CR (256 games: blocks LadPomcpA/B/C) with chat trading, on the same seeded boards, decks, first players, seats and dice as the POMCP blocks of the 2026-11-09 planner_pv2_tiles ladder receipt.

pomcp_ts_cr.source: Dobre & Lascarides, POMCP with Human Preferences in Settlers of Catan (AIIDE 2018), POMCP-TS-CR; paper setting 10k iterations, 4 threads, C=4 with PUCT, offers limit 3

stac_negotiator.source: STAC's JSettlers-derived negotiating agent (soc.robot.stac.StacRobotBrain via StacRobotFactory, default StacRobotType): negotiates trades in STAC's chat format

limitations: STAC's MCTS agents are not reproducible even when seeded, so pairing removes environment luck (board, deck, first player, seats, dice by roll index, steals, discards) but not opponent-play variance. Seats come from STAC's seeded shuffle, not a rotation (position counts are recorded and identical across the pair). The 10 s per-search cap deviates from the paper's uncapped 10k iterations; cap hits and >1 s overruns are counted. Our bot never counter-offers. The control is the historical 2026-11-09 planner_pv2_tiles ladder receipt, not a concurrent run: host load differs (ultra is shared now), so MCTS time budgets and cap hits may differ between the pair; both are recorded and reported.
predeclared: 2026-11-11 before any STAC game of this candidate (POMCP blocks of the 2026-11-08 stac-ladder design).
note: Predeclared 2026-11-11 before any STAC game of this candidate. Supersedes experiments/stac-va-t9.json, whose run never played (aborted at startup on the Cython checkpoint selection, board #1). The STAC negotiator table is dropped from the promotion bar (Jerry 2026-11-11: 'stop negotiator for promotion bar'). scripts/stac_paired.py --expect pomcp_ts_cr=256 pairs these blocks by seed with the historical tiles receipt restricted to its POMCP blocks.
